about: What a lighting designer asks while making a BOQ, and how each must be read. The teaching set for app/catalogue_query.py: scripts/maintenance/ask_eval.py runs every one against the real catalogue. A new way of asking gets a row here first, then a vocabulary row. 'reads' lists what must be understood; 'not_left' means no word may go unread.
